children: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V extended the shareholder redemption deadline for its proposed business combination with GOWell to 5:00 p.m. ET on September 2, 2026.
Redemption deadline moved from Sept. 1, 2026 to 5:00 p.m. ET on Sept. 2, 2026 to allow additional time for shareholders to act.
Shareholders may withdraw previously submitted redemption requests by contacting the transfer agent before the new deadline.
Registration Statement including the Proxy Statement/Prospectus was declared effective by the SEC on Aug. 11, 2026; definitive proxy mailed to record shareholders as of June 30, 2026.
Filing notes forward-looking risks and advises shareholders to review the Proxy Statement/Prospectus and other SEC filings before voting or investing.
